rationale: Max scenario net load per period: t1=max(60,72,72)=72, t2=max(61,76,77)=77, t3=max(55,69,68)=69. Adding 8 MW reserve yields required thermal generation 80/85/77. Meeting demand at least cost loads the cheaper g1 (18/MWh) to its pmax=70 in every period, covering the remainder with g2 (36/MWh) at 10/15/7 MW, all within pmin/pmax. Worst-case margins equal the 8 MW reserve; total cost = 18*(70+70+70) + 36*(10+15+7) = 3780 + 1152 = 4932.
